title_original: The Film Comment Podcast: NYFF64 Festival Report
excerpt_original: Critics Bilge Ebiri and Molly Haskell join for a spirited wrap-up of this year’s edition

blocks.text: As the 64th New York Film Festival drew to a close last week, it was once again time for Film Comment ’s Festival Report, our annual live overview of the NYFF that was. Critics Bilge Ebiri and Molly Haskell joined Film Comment Editors Clinton Krute and Devika Girish for a spirited wrap-up analysis of the highlights and lowlights from this year’s lineup. The panel discussed and debated Lee Chang-dong’s Possible Love , Chris Rock’s Misty Green , Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s You Can See Everything , Valeska Grisebach’s The Dreamed Adventure , Luca Guadagnino’s Artificial , Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor’s NAZA , Sompot Chidgasornpongse’s 9 Temples to Heaven , and many more selections.
A movie that you can’t shake, for good or bad? (29:30)
